sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "clinicians"."facconnect" AS e, "facilities"."leglissue" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "clinicians" JOIN "facilities" ON "facilities"."fackey" = "clinicians"."facconnect"  GROUP BY "clinicians"."facconnect", "facilities"."leglissue"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the all total of number of clinicians records (all level)
rank within the group by number of clinicians records: share of the all total, keep the top 3
